purpose: Complete the substantive price-revaluation diagnostic on existing actual disclosure windows, including feasibility of the original full-portfolio AT. Not a search for a favorable p-value.
fixed_rules: Do not collect new data, rerun LLM, change protected inputs or overwrite previous results. Bulk and model fits stay on PC.
Use sealed exact-window S, labels, controls and maturity/identity screens without residualizing or standardizing S again on the priced subset.
Price pairs reuse the previous observed positive RUB CLOSE, seven-day backward-only, board, bond historical face-value/currency rules. No favorable quote selection or zero missing return.

Rebuild complete opening/closing universes only for the same eligible actual intervals used for M4; full-portfolio AT requires all opening exposure priced or documented accepted cash and reconciled weights, no covered-subportfolio renormalization.

Full-AT models use union of opening and closing positions; actual closing-month FE and log interval days. Relative log models use continuing strictly positive reported values and accepted quote pairs, FE fund x security and fund-specific interval.
All relative outcomes must use the same retained rows, X and FE; check log-value-growth beta = adjusted-log-growth beta + log-price-growth beta numerically.
Continue to label log price-adjusted value growth as an implied position-growth proxy, not observed quantities, original AT or fund alpha.
Keep current four controls; log interval days included, allowed absorbed/collinear controls recorded. No extra asset/year/outlier selection.
One bounded run of the fixed models; genuine implementation errors may be repaired with failed source snapshots. No outcome-driven specification additions.

models.sample: All valid exact-window target rows in complete-price full portfolios; union positions
Same valid continuing positive positions with observed price pairs as E3
Identical final rows to E2; log(V1/V0)-log(P1/P0)
Identical rows/X/FE to E2/E3; diagnostic decomposition only

covariance_grid.nested_rule: Verify nesting in any selected dimension; exact remaining FE rank, constant A=1 if all FE nested. No double subtraction.
covariance_grid.reference_df: minimum marginal cluster count minus one
covariance_grid.PSD: No clipping; unavailable variances/inference null with reasons

multiplicity: Holm32 within each substantive model-pair family
tests.unavailable: Keep all fixed slots; null raw inference, p=1 only adjustment bookkeeping

deliverables: PC Parquet panels and immutable code/plan snapshots
completion_checks: Full-AT denominator coverage and exact matched rows
Same samples and S for relative outcome decomposition
Report all fixed cells and unavailable branches
SE CI p H1 H2 Holm arithmetic
Independent code/data QA and method interpretation
interpretation: No claim of hypothesis confirmation merely from a selected p; original full AT and alpha requirements remain distinct. This finite bridge adds a substantive missing price check, not more arbitrary clustering.
